---
title: "debug_getRawTransaction"
---

Returns the EIP-2718 binary-encoded transaction for a transaction hash.

This method will use `80` [Compute Units](/v1/about/billing).

***

<Info>

This method is served by nanoreth, the HyperEVM archive client, and works for any block back to genesis. On blocks that carry a HyperCore deposit, block-level traces include the deposit as their first entry; see [Overview](/v1/hyperliquid/overview).

</Info>

## **Parameters**

`tx_hash` - String <span style={{color: "red"}}>Required</span>  - The transaction hash.

## **Returns**

`result` - The EIP-2718 binary-encoded transaction, as a hexadecimal string.

```json wrap
// Result
{
	"jsonrpc": "2.0",
	"result": "",
	"id": 1
}
```

<CodeGroup>

```bash title="mainnet"
curl https://mainnet.hyperliquid.validationcloud.io/v1/<YOUR_API_KEY_HERE>/evm \
    -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"debug_getRawTransaction","params":["0x86a487d74f726697ffc06cca32975d8217142401ee459a1a604b8174315f2378"],"id":1}'
    
```

</CodeGroup>
